Package neqsim.process.engineering.production

Class EngineeringExternalEvidenceDocumentIntegrity

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.engineering.production.EngineeringExternalEvidenceDocumentIntegrity
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class EngineeringExternalEvidenceDocumentIntegrity extends Object implements Serializable
Binds external engineering evidence receipts to the actual supplied document bytes.

The simulator verifies content integrity only. It does not create, sign, accept, or approve an external decision.
